title: Fragments of Time
description: A 2D puzzle-platformer where players shift between an ancient temple of the past and its decayed future. Using time-travel mechanics and echo abilities to solve environmental puzzles, players must restore the Crystal of Aeons and piece together a forgotten story.
Highlights: Dual-timeline temporal shifting mechanic enabling seamless real-time transitions between past and future temple environments
Echo and Shadow Echo projection abilities allowing players to duplicate actions and solve collaborative multi-switch puzzles
Custom URP Shader Graph post-processing glitch and swirl distortion effects for cinematic temporal transitions
Dynamic 2D physics puzzles featuring kinetic momentum preservation, pressure plate triggers, and breakable obstacles
Cross-platform WebGL build pipeline deployed to Itch.io with responsive 2D Cinemachine camera tracking and adaptive cutscenes
